currentKey.empty: No signing key configured. Generate or import one below.

generateDialog.title: Generate new signing key
generateDialog.description: This will create a fresh Ed25519 key pair. The current active key will be deactivated. Connectors verifying in-flight tokens will still find the old public key until those tokens expire.

errors.importEmpty: Paste a private key before importing.

eSign.label: Require signature on approval tokens
eSign.description: When enabled, every approval token is signed with the active Ed25519 key. Connectors verify the signature before executing. When disabled, tokens carry the full payload and binding but no cryptographic signature — replay and expiry checks still apply.
